Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the use of certified mail.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of certified mail; and amending RCW1.12.060.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 1.12.060 and 1961 c 204 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Whenever the use of "registered" mail is authorized by thiscode, "certified" mail, with return receipt requested, may be used. (2) Whenever the use of "certified mail with a return receiptrequested" is authorized or required by this code, electronic returnreceipt delivery confirmation provided by the United States postalservice may be used.
